accueil.title: Over9: the workout tracker where every level is earned
accueil.description: Workout tracker for Android: log your sets, track your records, and level up only when you actually train. No account required, no trackers, paid once.
accueil.h1: Your progress is earned under the bar
accueil.chapeau: Over9 logs your sets in a few taps, tracks your records, and raises your level — only when you actually train.
accueil.bientot: Coming soon to Google Play · Android

seance.h2: Your session, logged in a few taps
seance.p: Start a workout: each exercise opens pre-filled with your last session. Adjust a weight or the reps, then save. The plate calculator tells you what to load on each side of the bar. Each exercise can show your own image: a photo you take with your phone, or any image you choose.
seance.alt_seance: Session in progress: bench press, pre-filled with the last session (195 × 3, 185 × 9, 175 × 7)
seance.alt_disques: Plate calculator: 195 lbs is 45 + 25 + 5 on each side of a 45 lb bar

niveau.p: The home screen shows your level and how many sessions stand between you and the next one. A session is a day you actually trained: opening the app doesn't count.
niveau.alt: Over9 home screen at level 18, with its golden aura

auras.p: Every level is earned under the bar, one session after another — and your aura changes along the way.

records.p: Every set you log feeds the exercise's records and its chart over time: heaviest weight, most reps, and the goal you set yourself.
records.alt: Exercise statistics: weight and rep records, chart of the heaviest weight over time

corps.h2: A 3D body that reads your training
corps.p: It shows where your weekly volume stands against the target of ten sets per muscle group, which muscles are lagging, where you are progressing, and any pain you report. And when you don't know what to train, it suggests today's session.
corps.alt_volume: 3D body, Balance view: weekly sets per muscle group against a target of ten
corps.alt_progression: 3D body, Progress view: improvement by region over 30 days
corps.alt_seance: What to do today: a suggested session for the muscles that are ready

historique.p: The calendar marks your training days, and every session keeps its sets, weights, and reps.
historique.alt: History: October 2026 calendar and the sets of one session

promesses.p: No account required: the app runs on your phone, even offline. If you turn on sync, a copy goes to your own Google Drive, and nowhere else.
No advertising and no analytics, in the app or on this site.
A single purchase. No subscription, nothing to unlock later.
The app follows your phone's language, or the one you pick for it.

support.title: Support · Over9
support.description: Over9 help: Google Drive sync, changing phones, refunds, languages, deleting your data, contact.
support.corps_html:
A question, a bug, an idea: write to contact@over9fit.com. We answer in English or French.

How do I back up my sessions to Google Drive?

In the ☰ menu, open Settings and sign in with your Google account. The app then asks for access to your Drive: it only sees the files it creates itself, in a folder named Over9FitApp. You can let Auto-upload to Drive do the work, or tap Sync now.

Sync is optional: without it, everything stays on your phone.

I'm changing phones: how do I get my data back?

Install Over9 on the new phone with the same Google Play account, sign in with the same Google account in Settings, and sync: your sessions come back from your Drive.

If sync was never enabled on the old phone, your data never left it: sync from the old phone first.

Does the app work offline?

Yes. You can log and view everything offline; only syncing with Drive needs a connection.

How do I get a refund?

Purchases go through Google Play, which handles refunds. You can refund the app yourself from Google Play within two hours of buying it. After that, Google reviews refund requests made within 48 hours of purchase. Past that, write to us at contact@over9fit.com.

How do I change the app's language?

The app follows your phone's language. You can also give it a different one without touching the rest of the phone: in the ☰ menu, Settings → Language, or in your phone's settings, Settings → Apps → Over9 → Language. Nine languages are available: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

How do I delete all my data?

On your phone: uninstalling the app deletes everything it keeps there.

On your Drive: the copy belongs to you; delete the Over9FitApp folder. To remove the app's access to your Google account: myaccount.google.com/permissions.

In your Android backup: if your phone's backup is on, Android may copy the app's data into it (never your progress photos). You manage it in your phone's backup settings.

We have nothing to delete on our side: the app's data never reaches us. The details are in the privacy policy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy · Over9
privacy.description: Privacy policy of the Over9 Android app and over9fit.com: your data stays on your phone and in your own Google Drive.
privacy.corps_html:
In short. Your data stays on your phone. If you turn on sync, a copy goes to your own Google Drive. We receive none of your data: no servers of our own, no account with us, no advertising, no analytics, no trackers. You can delete everything yourself, at any time.

Responsibility and contact

This policy covers the Over9 Android app, distributed on Google Play, and this website, over9fit.com.

Person in charge of the protection of personal information: the developer of Over9, at contact@over9fit.com.

What the app stores on your phone

  • Your exercises, workouts and sessions: sets, weights, reps and other measurements, dates, notes, tags, and favorites.
  • Pain you report: the affected area (a muscle or a joint), the date you report it and the date you clear it. This is health data: it stays under your control, just like everything else.
  • Your progress photos, if you take any, and the images you add to your exercises.
  • Your settings.
  • If you sign in with Google: your account's name, email address, and profile photo link, to show who is signed in.

Everything is stored in the app's private storage on your phone. We have no access to it. If your phone's Google backup is on, Android includes this data in it, except progress photos.

The app uses the camera only when you take a photo: a progress photo, or an exercise image. It needs no other sensitive permission.

Syncing with your Google Drive (optional)

If you sign in with your Google account and allow Drive access, the app copies to your Drive, in a folder named Over9FitApp: your training data (including reported pain), your exercise images, your progress photos, and archives of their previous versions.

  • The permission requested is drive.file: the app sees and changes only the files it created itself. It has no access to the rest of your Drive.
  • Data travels directly between your phone and Google, encrypted in transit (HTTPS). It never goes through us.
  • This copy is kept by Google under its own terms and privacy policy.

Your Google account data

  • Access: through Sign in with Google, your name, email address, and profile photo link; through the drive.file Drive permission, only the files the app created.
  • Use: showing the signed-in account, and saving then reading back the copy of your data in your Drive. Nothing else: no advertising, no profiling, no sale, no training of artificial intelligence models.
  • Storage: your name, email address, and profile photo link on your phone; your files in your Drive. The app stores no password.
  • Sharing: none. This data never reaches us, and the app passes it to no one.

What we don't do

  • No servers of our own, no account to create with us.
  • No advertising.
  • No analytics, audience measurement, or tracking tools, in the app or on this site.
  • No selling, renting, or sharing of data.

Third-party services involved

  • Google Play handles purchases, refunds, installation, and updates, under Google's privacy policy.

If you email us

If you email us, we use your address and message only to answer you, and keep them for as long as it takes to handle your request.

This website

over9fit.com uses no cookies, no analytics, and no third-party content.

Retention and deletion

  • On your phone: your data stays until you delete it in the app or uninstall the app, which erases it from your phone.
  • In your phone's Google backup: kept by Google with the rest of that backup, under its own terms.
  • In your Drive: as long as you keep it there. Delete the Over9FitApp folder to erase it, and remove the app's access at myaccount.google.com/permissions.

We hold no other data about you.

Security

Android isolates the app's data in its private storage. Exchanges with Google are encrypted. Access to your Drive goes through a Google permission you can withdraw at any time, and the app only sees its own files.

Your rights

You can ask us for access to your information, its rectification, or its deletion at contact@over9fit.com, or lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.

Changes

If this policy changes, the date at the top of the page changes with it. A significant change will also be announced in the app's release notes.
